channel.title: Oceanfront Property Hunt
channel.desc: Lisa and Kelly are ready for a new adventure and have set their sights on Cape Breton as the place they hope to call home. With their youngest daughter Brittney along for the ride, they are searching for the perfect forever home that lets them embrace coastal living while still giving Brittney the space to grow and thrive. Will they find a home that makes it all possible?
